name: app
description: Satori Protocol: an immutable SATORI token plus a UUPS-upgradeable prediction engine, hub and children, with a dapp, indexer and Nostr bridge. See docs/CODE_INDEX.md for the canonical file list.

scripts.fuzz:build: bash -c 'export PATH="$HOME/.foundry/bin:$PATH"; command -v forge >/dev/null 2>&1 || bash satori/scripts/setup-foundry.sh; forge build --root satori'
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run fuzz:build && npm run forge
scripts.invariant: bash -c 'export PATH="$HOME/.foundry/bin:$PATH"; cd satori && forge test --match-path "test/foundry/*.invariant.t.sol"'
scripts.forge: bash -c 'export PATH="$HOME/.foundry/bin:$PATH"; cd satori && forge test --no-match-path "test/foundry/*.halmos.t.sol"'
scripts.invariant:deep: bash -c 'export PATH="$HOME/.foundry/bin:$PATH"; cd satori && FOUNDRY_PROFILE=deep forge test --match-path "test/foundry/*.invariant.t.sol"'
scripts.invariant:marathon: bash -c 'export PATH="$HOME/.foundry/bin:$PATH"; cd satori && FOUNDRY_PROFILE=marathon forge test --match-path "test/foundry/*.invariant.t.sol"'
scripts.halmos: bash -c 'export PATH="$HOME/.foundry/bin:$PATH"; cd satori && halmos --contract ConservationArithmeticHalmos --solver-timeout-assertion 180000'
scripts.supersim:start: bash -c 'export PATH="$HOME/.foundry/bin:$PATH"; command -v supersim >/dev/null || { echo "supersim not installed — brew install ethereum-optimism/tap/supersim, or grab a release binary from github.com/ethereum-optimism/supersim/releases"; exit 1; }; supersim --interop.autorelay'
scripts.layout:check: cd satori && npx hardhat run scripts/check-storage-layout.js
scripts.layout:snapshot: cd satori && LAYOUT_SNAPSHOT=1 npx hardhat run scripts/check-storage-layout.js
